tagline: Attach Drive contracts and proposals to Salesforce deals automatically
metaTitle: Salesforce + Google Drive Integration: Deal Folders
metaDescription: Create Drive folders from Salesforce opportunities and attach documents to deal records. GAIA advances signed deals. See the setup steps.
intro:
Enterprise sales deals generate extensive documentation — proposals, NDAs, statements of work, contracts, legal amendments — that lives in Google Drive while the deal record lives in Salesforce. Without automation, reps spend time searching for the latest version of a proposal, and document links on deal records go stale when files are moved or renamed.

GAIA connects the two so deal documentation is always organized and accessible from the CRM. When an opportunity is created, GAIA creates a structured folder for the account. As documents are created or signed in Drive, GAIA attaches them to the Salesforce deal record with the correct document type and version. When a contract is executed, GAIA advances the deal stage automatically.

This integration is essential for enterprise sales teams managing complex documentation cycles, legal and procurement teams who need audit trails of contract versions, and revenue operations teams who need document accessibility to be automatic rather than reliant on individual rep habits.

useCases.title: Create Drive account folders from Salesforce opportunities
useCases.description: When an opportunity is created or reaches a qualifying stage, GAIA creates a structured Google Drive folder for the account with subfolders for proposals, contracts, legal documents, and supporting materials.

useCases.title: Auto-attach documents to deal records
useCases.description: When a proposal, contract, or SOW is added to an account's folder, GAIA automatically attaches the file to the linked opportunity record with the document type labeled, keeping deal files accessible from the CRM.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage when contracts are signed
useCases.description: When an executed contract is added to the signed documents subfolder, GAIA advances the opportunity to Closed Won, records the contract date, and creates the post-sale handoff task automatically.

useCases.title: Notify reps when documents require action
useCases.description: When a legal team member adds comments or a revised version of a contract to the folder, GAIA creates a task for the account executive to review and respond, keeping the contract cycle moving.

useCases.title: Generate proposals from Salesforce data
useCases.description: When an opportunity reaches the proposal stage, GAIA creates a proposal document from a template pre-filled with opportunity data (company name, products, pricing, key contacts), saving the rep manual document setup time.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Google Drive. Specify the root folder where account folders should be created and the pipelines to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder templates and document rules
howItWorks.description: Define the folder structure for new opportunities and the rules GAIA uses to attach files to deal records, by document type, subfolder location, or file naming convention.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps deal documents organized and CRM-linked
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both tools for changes, creating folders, attaching documents, advancing deal stages, and notifying reps so the CRM always reflects the current state of your deal documentation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA generate a proposal draft from a Salesforce opportunity on demand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask GAIA to generate a proposal for a specific opportunity and it will create a document from your template, populate it with opportunity and contact data, and attach it to the deal record.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support multiple document versions on the same deal record?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA attaches each document version to the record with a version label and timestamp. Previous versions remain accessible and the latest version is flagged as current.

faqs.question: Can GAIA enforce document naming conventions when creating Drive files?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can define file naming templates that GAIA applies when creating documents from CRM data — for example, using opportunity name, account, and date in the file name for consistent organization.
